title: WhatsApp Catalogue Guides and How-Tos | OneCatalog
description: WhatsApp catalogue guides for small shops: fix a catalogue that is not showing, rejected items and save errors, set up your catalogue and share the link.
h1: WhatsApp catalogue guides for shop owners
answer: These WhatsApp catalogue guides help you fix common problems, set up a catalogue and share it with customers. We check every step against the WhatsApp Help Center. Each guide lists its sources and the date we last checked it.
waText: Hi OneCatalog, I have a question about my WhatsApp catalogue.

cards.title: WhatsApp catalogue not showing? 7 fixes
cards.text: Items in review, rejected or hidden, and an app glitch.

cards.title: "Item wasn't saved" error
cards.text: The 6 real causes of the save error and the fix for each.

cards.title: Catalog item rejected
cards.text: What WhatsApp bans, the photo mistakes to avoid and how to appeal.

cards.title: Catalog approval time
cards.text: How long it takes, and what to check if an item is stuck.

cards.title: Catalog price not showing
cards.text: Where the price goes, and why it may not show.

cards.title: Catalog link not working
cards.text: Old phones, broken links, empty catalogues and more.

cards.title: How to add a catalog to WhatsApp Business
cards.text: Step by step for Android and iPhone.

cards.title: WhatsApp catalogue categories
cards.text: Group your products, and pick your business type.

cards.title: Catalog bulk upload
cards.text: Add many products at once with a spreadsheet.

cards.title: Catalog product limit
cards.text: What WhatsApp says about how many items you can add.

cards.title: How to make a product catalogue
cards.text: Seven steps from choosing products to sharing the link.

cards.title: How to share your WhatsApp catalog link
cards.text: In a chat, on status or in another app, plus what to send when a customer asks.

cards.title: WhatsApp catalog vs website catalog
cards.text: The two side by side, and when each one fits.

blocks.p: We build catalogue websites for small shops from the photos and prices you send on WhatsApp. It works next to your WhatsApp catalogue. Read how it works on our [WhatsApp catalogue page](/whatsapp-catalogue). See the [plans and prices](/pricing). Or find the page for your trade, like [furniture](/catalogue-maker/furniture), [tiles and sanitaryware](/catalogue-maker/tiles-sanitaryware) or [handicrafts](/catalogue-maker/handicrafts).
